name: qwen-audio-3.1-asr-flash-streaming
description: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Streaming is an end-to-end real-time speech recognition model designed for live meetings, real-time captions, and intelligent interaction. It delivers low-latency, high-accuracy streaming transcription with support for multiple languages, regional Chinese dialects, seamless Chinese-English switching, hotwords, contextual enhancement, punctuation prediction, and text normalization. The model is robust to noise and complex acoustic environments, and supports controllable ASR/AST output across multiple dialects.
zhDescription: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Streaming端到端实时语音识别大模型，面向实时会议、直播字幕与智能交互等场景，具备低延迟、高精度的流式语音转写能力。模型支持多语种与多地区中文方言识别、中英文自由切换、热词及上下文增强、标点预测与文本规范化，并具备较强的噪声鲁棒性，可适应复杂声学环境。同时该版本支持多种方言 ASR/AST 可控输出。
